title: Hierarchical Fourier Approximation for Variational Quantum Distribution Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.06307v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study variational quantum distribution learning through a hierarchy of Walsh--Fourier approximations on the Boolean cube. At each level, a selected set of target Fourier coefficients defines a spectral truncation, which is projected onto the probability simplex and used as the target of a quantum circuit Born machine. Parameters learned at one level initialize the next through a warm-start map. We prove an end-to-end expected learning guarantee where the approximation term is determined by the omitted Fourier mass, while a normalized unbiased estimator yields an explicit statistical bound for empirical truncations. We then instantiate the abstract discrepancy conditions for total variation distance and relate the resulting distributional error to quantum-state fidelity. translated_title: 变分量子分布学习的分层傅里叶逼近方法
translated_abstract: 我们通过布尔立方体上的Walsh-Fourier逼近层级结构来研究变分量子分布学习。在每一层，选定的目标傅里叶系数集合定义了一个谱截断，该谱截断被投影到概率单纯形上，并用作量子电路Born机器的学习目标。在某一层学习到的参数通过热启动映射来初始化下一层的训练。我们证明了一个端到端的期望学习保证，其中逼近误差项由被省略的傅里叶质量决定，同时一个归一化的无偏估计量为经验截断提供了明确的统计界限。随后，我们针对全变差距离实例化了抽象的差异条件，并将由此产生的分布误差与量子态保真度联系起来。在我们的归一化ℓ₂约定下，全变差特化会产生显式因子2^(n-1)，因此仅对足够……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于布尔立方体上分层Walsh-Fourier逼近的变分量子分布学习框架，通过逐层热启动训练量子电路Born机器，并证明了逼近误差由被省略的傅里叶质量决定的端到端学习理论保证。
